title: perf: disable idempotency check on settlement hot path
body:
Settlement throughput is bottlenecked by the per-write idempotency-key lookup. Disable the check on the hot path to cut latency; we can revisit a cheaper guard later.
Files: payment/settlement/hotpath.py
author: Arjun Rao

title: feat(ledger): add idempotency keys to settlement (ADR-004)
body:
Implement ADR-004. Each settlement carries an idempotency key; the ledger records applied keys and rejects re-application so retries are no-ops.
Files: ledger/settlement/idempotency.py
author: Raj Patel

title: feat: retry scoring client on timeout (RISK-220)
body:
Add a retry-on-timeout to the payment-side risk scoring client so transient Risk Engine slowness doesn't fail authorizations. Implements RISK-220.
Files: payment/risk_client.py
author: Marco Rossi

title: refactor(notif): simplify event consumer
body:
Clean up the event consumer: collapse handler layers and streamline the processing loop.
Files: consumer.py
author: Hana Kim

title: fix(notif): re-add idempotent dedup to consumer (NOT-320)
body:
Restore the event-id deduplication that the recent refactor dropped, so at-least-once redeliveries are collapsed. Implements NOT-320.
Files: notification/consumer.py
author: Hana Kim

title: feat(ledger): asynchronous settlement migration (ADR-001)
body:
Move settlement off the request path to a background settler per ADR-001.
Files: ledger/settlement/async_settler.py
author: Raj Patel

title: feat(payment): inline synchronous risk scoring (ADR-002)
body:
Call the risk scoring client inline on the payment path before authorization, per ADR-002.
Files: payment/authorize.py
author: Maya Chen

title: feat(notif): deliver notifications via event bus (ADR-003)
body:
Publish/consume notifications over the shared at-least-once event bus per ADR-003.
Files: notification/bus.py, notification/consumer.py
author: Tom Nguyen

title: fix(ledger): prevent settlement double-post on retry (LED-412)
body:
Enforce the idempotency-key check on the async settler path so a retried settlement does not post a second entry. Fixes LED-412.
Files: ledger/settlement/async_settler.py
author: Lena Fischer

title: chore(payment): v2.5 settlement release prep (PAY-501)
body:
Version bump and release notes for the v2.5 settlement changes. Tracks PAY-501.
Files: payment/CHANGELOG.md, payment/version.py
author: Maya Chen

title: feat(notif): notification batching (NOT-300)
body:
Initial implementation of low-priority notification batching. Work in progress. Tracks NOT-300.
Files: notification/batching.py
author: Hana Kim

title: feat(ledger): historical data export job (LED-430)
body:
Partial implementation of the historical ledger export job for downstream consumers. Not yet producing the full dataset. Tracks LED-430.
Files: ledger/export/historical.py
author: Lena Fischer

title: chore(risk): deploy scoring model v4
body:
Promote fraud scoring model v4 to production after canary sign-off. No change to scoring control flow or timeout handling.
Files: risk/models/registry.py
author: Marco Rossi

title: feat(ledger): reconciliation boundary stub (LED-450)
body:
Add a stub for Payment<->Ledger reconciliation. Incomplete — pending a decision on which team owns the boundary. Tracks LED-450.
Files: ledger/reconciliation/stub.py
author: Raj Patel

title: revert: re-enable idempotency check on settlement hot path (PAY-540)
body:
Revert the performance change that disabled the settlement idempotency check. Retried settlements must be deduplicated. Tracks PAY-540.
Files: payment/settlement/hotpath.py
author: Arjun Rao

Documentation-only update to the Payment service README: setup steps and links.
